fields.description: Weekly issue dated December 31, 1927 (Vol. 4, No. 46), edited by Wen R. Phillips. Includes New Year-themed editorials and satire about Miami’s prospects for 1928, criticism of local reformers and their impact on tourism, and commentary on parking/traffic policies (including Flagler Street). Contains pieces on the Democratic national convention prospects, Miami Shores lighting, Hialeah racing and greyhound track references, aviation and flying field development, and local business/restaurant conditions, alongside columns, humor/fiction, legal notices, and extensive local advertising for Miami and Miami Beach entertainment and services.
